title: Tow the Yard
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Tow the Yard and the helm marks Tug Yard. Do: Close on Tug Yard. The Tug Factor matches your nose inside 480 meters and holds the tow. The escort contract is the separate arrival. Finish: come inside Tug Yard's shell. The Charter writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
